description_en: Retrieves the details of the DDoS mitigation thresholds or traffic scrubbing thresholds for specified assets. The assets can be elastic IP addresses (EIPs). The assets can also be Elastic Compute Service (ECS) instances or Server Load Balancer (SLB) instances that are assigned public IP addresses
description_zh: 查询当前阿里云账号下指定公网IP资产（云服务器ECS实例、负载均衡SLB实例、弹性公网IP实例）的DDoS防护阈值或流量清洗阈值详情
kebab_example: aliyun antiddos-public describe-ddos-threshold --ddos-region-id cn-hangzhou --ddos-type defense --instance-type ecs --instance-ids i-bp10bclrt56fblts0000 --region cn-hangzhou
name: DescribeDdosThreshold

parameters.help_en:
The region ID of the asset.

You can call the https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/353250.html operation to query the most recent region list
parameters.help_zh:
要查询的公网IP资产所在地域ID。

您可以调用https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/353250.html查询所有地域ID
parameters.name: ddos_region_id

parameters.help_en:
The type of the threshold. Valid values:

defense: traffic scrubbing threshold

blackhole: DDoS mitigation threshold
parameters.help_zh:
要查询的阈值类型。取值：

defense：表示查询流量清洗阈值。
blackhole：表示查询DDoS防护阈值
parameters.name: ddos_type

parameters.help_en:
The type of the asset that is assigned a public IP address. Valid values:

ecs: ECS instances.

slb: SLB instances.

eip: EIPs.

ipv6: IPv6 gateways.

swas: simple application servers.

waf: Web Application Firewall (WAF) instances of the Exclusive edition.

ga_basic: Global Accelerator (GA) instances
parameters.help_zh:
要查询的公网IP资产的实例类型。取值：

ecs：表示查询云服务器ECS实例。
slb：表示查询负载均衡SLB实例。
eip：表示查询弹性公网IP实例。
ipv6：表示查询IPv6网关公网实例。
swas：表示查询轻量服务器公网实例。
waf：表示查询Web应用防火墙独享实例。
ga_basic：表示查询全球加速公网实例
parameters.name: instance_type

parameters.help_en: The ID of asset N to query
parameters.help_zh: 要查询的公网IP资产的实例ID列表
parameters.name: instance_ids

RequestId.description_en: The ID of the request, which is used to locate and troubleshoot issues
RequestId.description_zh: 本次调用请求的ID，是由阿里云为该请求生成的唯一标识符，可用于排查和定位问题
